geometry.locator: arXiv:2401.07684, 'positioned at 17.1 m from the reactor core center'
geometry.note: CONUS's own paper (arXiv:2401.07684) states the detector sat 17.1 m from the reactor core center at Brokdorf, inside the reactor building itself (not a separate structure). No source consulted gives the azimuth of that 17.1 m offset from the core, so this point is the centroid of the OSM 'Reaktorgebäude' building (geometry:brokdorf-core), used directly as the detector's position. The stated accuracy is 40 m: the unresolved 17.1 m offset plus up to about 21 m between the polygon centroid and the reactor axis (a circle fitted to the 13 vertices of the polygon's circular arc, radius 40.2 m, residual <= 2.7 m, is centred 20.4 m SSW of the centroid, at 9.3457897 E 53.8505931 N; no source states whether that arc is concentric with the core).

summary.plain: The approximate position of the CONUS coherent-neutrino-scattering detector, which sat inside the Brokdorf reactor building 17.1 m from the reactor core, 2018-2023.
